items.reason: Describes the same raw fetch Response returned in sync mode despite callers expecting provider-specific token shapes.
Explicitly identifies the computed schema keys that fail to preserve token fields. The broader comment also includes the hardcoded refresh-token problem described in #07.
Describes storing the safeParse wrapper as Google's credential key instead of its parsed data.
Describes the same unreliable statusText check and subsequent use of stale Salesforce credentials covered by this issue.
Identifies Bigin passing the credential row ID as the user ID to the sync helper.
Describes the same concurrent findFirst-then-create race that inserts duplicate credential rows.
Concerns allowing credential mutations through GET requests. Adding a POST guard would not fix #02's unhandled payload parsing and decryption errors.
Describes the unconditional Salesforce token refresh during getClient even when the saved access token remains valid.
